functions.exact: def exact(x,keys):need(type(x) is dict and set(x)==set(keys),'FIELDS')
functions.integer: def integer(x,lo,hi):need(type(x) is int and lo<=x<=hi,'INTEGER');return x
functions.label: def label(x):need(type(x) is str and 0<len(x)<=128,'LABEL');return x
functions.digest: def digest(x):need(type(x) is str and len(x)==64 and all(c in '0123456789abcdef' for c in x),'DIGEST');return x
